provenance: Original content — Ashfall Reach, © 2026 Example Campaign
attribution: Written for this repository as content-pack test material. No SRD text is reproduced here.
note: A mid-tier volcanic-waste set: three creatures, the two spells the emberpriest casts, the conditions those spells apply, and the flasks the warband carries.

creatures.name: Ashfall Cinderling
unmodelled: Ash Cloud: the cinderling's square is lightly obscured while it lives
Death Burst: 1d4 fire to each creature within 5 feet when it drops to 0 hit points

creatures.name: Ashfall Slagwright
unmodelled: Heated Body: a creature that hits the slagwright with a melee attack takes 1d6 fire
It repairs its own plating during a short rest, regaining 10 hit points

creatures.name: Ashfall Emberpriest
unmodelled: Channel Ash: once per day it may reroll a failed Constitution save
It speaks the ash-cant, which the engine does not track

spells.name: Ashfall Emberburst
unmodelled: Ash left in the area is difficult terrain until the end of the caster's next turn

spells.name: Cinder Brand
unmodelled: The brand glows, making the target visible through smoke
The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns

conditions.name: ashfall-ember-marked
conditions.description: A glowing brand sits on the creature's skin; attackers can see exactly where to strike.

conditions.name: ashfall-cinder-blind
conditions.description: Hot grit fills the eyes. The creature strikes badly and is easy to strike.

items.name: Ashfall Ember Flask
items.description: A clay flask of banked embers that bursts alight on impact.

items.name: Slagwright Draught
items.description: Bitter mineral slurry the forge-crews drink between shifts.

items.name: Cinder-Grit Pouch
items.description: A fistful of sharp ash, thrown into the face.
unmodelled: A creature with no eyes is unaffected; the engine does not track anatomy
